2026-10-13.title: A little note for today
2026-10-13.message:
Some people make an ordinary day feel a little more special just by being in the world.

I hope today is gentle with you, and that something makes you smile.

2026-10-14.title: For your day
2026-10-14.message: Whatever today brings, I hope you find a reason to smile, a moment to breathe, and a little reminder that you matter.
